outcome: neonatal complications (IUFD, IUGR, macrosomia, congenital anomalies, neonatal hypoglycemia, respiratory distress, NICU admission)
cohort: 140 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) receiving antenatal care at Ain Shams Maternity hospital
finding: Metformin was as effective as insulin in controlling blood glucose levels and managing GDM, with similar rates of maternal and neonatal complications, but better BMI control and treatment compliance in the metformin group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were not significantly different between the metformin and insulin groups.
